steps.content: Originally tunnels from the Rustfire era, the underground shelter has been hastily converted, its conditions stark and primitive. Whenever tremors from the catastrophe above shake the foundations, a palpable wave of panic ripples through the caverns.

In this oppressive atmosphere, only the Speaker provides a glimmer of relief, playing the fool with such dedication that he becomes a beacon—the sole point of light in the overwhelming dark, drawing every eye and lifting every spirit he passes.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: The Speaker of the City Council is here! Your Max King has arrived with everything you need! You are not alone facing this catastrophe! I'm right here by your side. I'll—hm?
Just as he tries to rally people's spirits, a small, ragged figure stumbles out of the gloom and clutches desperately at his hand.

steps.speaker: Ragged Girl
steps.content: H-help me... Mr. Speaker...

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Are you alright? What happened—
Elvira?!
He recognizes her face and acts instantly, rubbing grime from his hands onto her features to disguise her, while speaking in a nervously urgent tone—

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Oh, so you're a Sinner. Is your Mania flaring up? Then you must stay away from the crowd. Hurry, this way—

The mention of a Sinner losing control makes the pursuing cameras hesitate and pull back. It is all the chance Max King needs. He grabs Elvira's hand, and they dash around the corner, disappearing into the long corridor.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Why are you here? What happened? What's going on at the Bureau?
Elvira doesn't respond immediately. After a brief hesitation, she speaks in a hushed voice.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Take me back to the Bureau first. I have something to do.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I also have some intelligence. I'll find a way to pass it to you later.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I see. I'll figure something out. You just need to blend in with the group of abnormal Sinners. They'll take you there.

A mere few days apart, and yet the girl's eyes hold a different light. The once-timid illegitimate daughter, who once clung to the Bureau and her close friends for safety, now throws herself into the front line. She has clearly found a purpose—and with it, a newfound strength.
Watching her, Max King can't help but feel a tinge of envy. The crowd swarms around them, making any meaningful words impossible. It isn't until the moment of parting that a question occurs to him.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: How did you know to find me here?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: You are on TV, aren't you? Lots of Syndicans have been watching. Some like you, some don't, but when they are all trapped in the shelter, everyone is wondering where Speaker King has gone.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: But you should be more careful. You're on TV so much. Anyone looking for you could easily find you. It's not safe. Watch your back, or you might get killed.
Max King freezes for a moment.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Many people have been watching... Anyone looking for me could easily find me...
His gaze sweeps over the crowd—faces marked by curiosity, excitement, disgust, and mockery. The reaction is unanimous: Max King commands attention wherever he goes.
And in this moment of stark recognition, a vague idea begins to take root.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: —Your Max King is here!
[Scene Change] Detention Cell
After a day of grueling interrogation, Selyna remains locked in her cell. As the brief, guard-free window approaches, she hears footsteps and immediately recognizes them. It's that strange brat.

Selyna thought the little nuisance would have cleared out by now. Yet the girl shows up again. The footsteps stop at the control console. After a few seconds of tinkering, Selyna feels the restraining field around her weaken.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: @#¥@#¥@ (What's that brat up to... I'm not going to fall for her tricks...)
The thought flashes through her mind just as a faint melody drifts by on the air.
[Empty Scene] Elvira hums a melody. Can reuse Jelena's humming segment or just use the audio file.
...Does DisCity have tunes like this? She feels she's heard it somewhere before... somewhere in Fraser...
She cranes her neck to look, but finds only the visitor's retreating back, the melody fading away with her footsteps.
[Dimly Lit Hospital Ward]

The sharp scent of disinfectant surrounds you. Your body trembles with fever, wracked by chills as you drift in and out of a fractured consciousness. The strange odor of anti-Mania rays permeates the room, irritating your nerves.
Nightmares descend, and they ensnare you.

steps.speaker: Shadow's Voice
steps.content: Get away... Get away...

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Stay back. This war is no place for you.
[White Flash] You finally manage to struggle upright and grab the person standing by your bed.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief?!
Your fingers close around Hecate's wrist. She startles at your touch, and the blanket she was adjusting slips from her grasp.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Sorry, I'm still a bit groggy...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you here? How would they let you come...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I was worried about you, Chief. I asked Adjutant Nightingale for permission to visit. Are you alright?
Labored breaths, a racing heart, a cold sweat—the symptoms scream through you. Hecate's gaze is heavy with worry. In the past, you would have instinctively told her: you're fine.
But now...
You just cover her hand with your own and speak softly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not feeling well, actually. The Mania is still affecting me. But I think I'll be fine.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need your help.
The black triangle quietly drifts over from the corner of the room.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I'll continue monitoring and suppressing Mania for you from outside your field of vision. That way, my presence won't unsettle you.
You lower your head briefly in thought, then look directly at it and say:

steps.speaker: Option
options: That was my bad. I shouldn't have taken my frustration out on you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've grown too reliant on you when it comes to managing the shackles' contamination. Every time the Mania fluctuates, I end up directing my anxiety at you. That wasn't fair. I need to work on controlling my emotions better. If anything, I should be thanking you.
Schorl emits a series of strange sounds, unlike anything you've heard before. You can't tell if it's expressing confusion or merely recording your unexpected speech.

Nevertheless, it proceeds as requested. It activates its anti-Mania program to scan you, though the process seems to run a few more cycles than usual. Seizing the opportunity, you pose your questions.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: BR-003 is fully calibrated. We hold the advantage now, Chief. There's no need for you to take unnecessary risks fighting against the Black Ring anymore. BR-005 is also within controllable parameters.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Are you planning to deploy BR-003?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It remains a deterrent and a last resort. Causing mass casualties is never our intention, even if it's framed as serving the greater good. As long as alternatives exist, we will exhaust them first.

steps.speaker: Option
options: So you're not launching a direct assault on BR-005?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The enemy has anticipated that approach. They've stationed numerous Apostles of Ashes around BR-005 as a defensive measure. A frontal assault with our current forces would be costly.
The black triangle rotates slightly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We've formulated a more efficient strategy. If executed correctly, we can achieve victory with minimal sacrifice. To avoid causing you undue concern, I will refrain from detailing the specifics for now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To avoid causing me undue concern... It means this plan doesn't include rescuing Hella, does it? You might even be prepared to sacrifice her to keep "minimal losses." Is that it?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We haven't reached that point yet.
With it, you feel its anti-Mania energy output slightly increasing. You make every effort to keep your composure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's very thoughtful of you to carefully omit that part for my sake. I should thank you for that.
At your words, it emits that strange sound again. You decide to press on anyway.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Receiving such special treatment, should I take this as...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm still useful to Paradeisos? You need me emotionally stable and compliant because you still have uses for me. Is that it?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...You are important, of course. You may voice your requests freely. We always give them careful consideration, though we cannot promise they will be fulfilled.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But that's not you. The reason you fight is far too frail.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...My goals haven't changed. But I can't keep making demands I know are impossible. Like she said, I still don't truly understand war. My convictions aren't strong enough.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't solve anything, can't even think clearly... because I've been drowning in confusion, anger, and pain. But that ends now. I can't keep avoiding questions just because I don't have answers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least I should find an answer, in my own way.
You look at Schorl, finally speaking with genuine sincerity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Would you be willing to listen? To help me find that answer?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The fact that you're approaching me honestly is progress in itself. Please state your request, Chief. I will convey it and await evaluation.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Then... I want to meet someone.
